cues.zh: 最富有的人和我们其他人之间的差距越来越大。
cues.en: The gap between the very richest and the rest of us is getting bigger.

cues.zh: 为什么？
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 一个普遍的看法是，如果一小群人赚到巨额财富，对我们所有人都有好处。
cues.en: A common belief is that it's good for us all if a small group of people earn an enormous

cues.zh: 钱。
cues.en: amount of money.

cues.zh: 理论是，他们的财富会涓滴到我们其他人身上。
cues.en: The theory is that their wealth trickles down to the rest of us.

cues.zh: 但这是个迷思。
cues.en: But this is a myth.

cues.zh: 现实中，钱是从我们所有人身上被吸走，进入一小群人的口袋。
cues.en: In reality, money is sucked up from all of us in to the pockets of a very small group

cues.zh: 人。
cues.en: of people.

cues.zh: 这是怎么发生的？
cues.en: How does this happen?

cues.zh: 一个原因是货币被创造出来的方式。
cues.en: One reason is the way that money is created.

cues.zh: 现在，我们经济中几乎所有的钱都是银行在发放贷款时创造出来的。
cues.en: Right now, almost all of the money in our economy is created by banks when they make

cues.zh: 贷款。
cues.en: loans.

cues.zh: 大多数人以为，银行发放贷款时，是把别人的储蓄借出去。
cues.en: Now most people assume that when banks make loans, they are lending out someone else's

cues.zh: 储蓄。
cues.en: savings.

cues.zh: 但并不是。
cues.en: But they are not.

cues.zh: 相反，当有人贷款时，银行通过电子方式创造新钱，在账户里输入数字。
cues.en: Instead when somebody takes out a loan, banks create new money electronically, by typing

cues.zh: 数字存入他们的账户。
cues.en: numbers in to their account.

cues.zh: 我们经济中 97% 的货币都是通过这种方式创造出来的，也就是人们向银行贷款
cues.en: 97% of all of the money in our economy is created in this way, as people take out loans

cues.zh: 的时候。
cues.en: from banks.

cues.zh: 人们借贷越多，债务就越多，货币也就越多。
cues.en: The more loans people take, the more debt there is, and the more money there is.

cues.zh: 令人震惊的事实是，如果没有人负债，经济中就几乎没有任何
cues.en: The shocking fact is that if nobody went into debt, there would be almost no money in the

cues.zh: 货币了。
cues.en: economy.

cues.zh: 我们的经济依赖于银行创造的电子货币。
cues.en: Our economy depends on the electronic money created by banks.

cues.zh: 但由于货币是在人们借贷时创造的，总有人在某个地方必须支付利息
cues.en: But because the money is created when people borrow, someone, somewhere, has to pay interest

cues.zh: 每创造一英镑都要付利息。
cues.en: on every pound created.

cues.zh: 实际上，我们是在向银行租用维持经济运转所需的资金。
cues.en: In effect we are renting the money we need to run our economy from the banks.

cues.zh: 这意味着仅在英国，我们每天就要共同向银行支付
cues.en: This means that in the UK alone, together we pay the banks £192 million in interest

cues.zh: 高达 1.92 亿英镑的利息。
cues.en: every single day.

cues.zh: 而且由于大部分债务由底层 90% 的人承担，财富却集中在顶层 10% 的人手中，
cues.en: And because the debt is held mostly by the bottom 90% and wealth mostly by the top 10%,

cues.zh: 支付这些利息实际上就是把底层 90% 人口的钱，转移到了
cues.en: paying this interest transfers money from the bottom 90% of the population to the very

cues.zh: 最顶层的 10% 手中。
cues.en: top 10%.

cues.zh: 它把财富和收入从我们其余人手里吸走，输送给极少数幸运儿。
cues.en: It sucks wealth and income from the rest of us up to the very lucky few.

cues.zh: 所以，只要我们还得向创造货币的银行租用我们使用的钱，我们就得
cues.en: So as long as we have to rent the money we use from the banks that create it, we'll have

cues.zh: 一直支付这笔巨额利息，而最富的人和其余人之间的差距
cues.en: to keep paying this huge interest bill, and the gap between the richest and the rest of

cues.zh: 会不断扩大。
cues.en: us will keep increasing.

cues.zh: 但有些创造货币的方式，并不需要我们所有人都向银行举债。
cues.en: But there are ways to create money that don't depend on us all going into debt to the banks.

cues.zh: 我们希望看到货币由公共机构创造并投入经济花掉，这样我们就不必
cues.en: We want to see money created by a public body and spent into the economy, so that we don't

cues.zh: 向银行借来我们需要的所有钱。
cues.en: have to borrow all of the money we need from banks.

cues.zh: 这会减少债务，并阻止最富的人和其余人之间的差距
cues.en: This would lead to less debt, and stop the gap between the richest and the rest of us

cues.zh: 进一步扩大。
cues.en: getting even bigger.

cues.zh: 这正是我们在推动的。
cues.en: This is what we're campaigning for.

cues.en: Join us by signing up at Positive Money and sharing this video.
